text:
morgan (partnerships): FYI Echolight sent their model bundle and wants to list on the Redwood marketplace next month. They're OK with redistributing the weights but have a few conditions re: attribution and embargo window. Want to sync on legal + SKU mapping.

echolight-contact: thanks! we'll need a 2-week embargo after final sign-off and want 'Echolight Research' attributed on the listing. license: CC-BY-4.0 + addenda (see attached link). happy to sign marketplace agreement.

tara (legal): put the addenda in this thread or DM me. CC-BY is generally fine but we need to confirm the addendum doesn't restrict redistribution or require additional approvals for quantized builds. @morgan can you drop the specific clause? :point_down: 

morgan (partnerships): copied the clause excerpt they highlighted: "Model weights may be redistributed in derivative formats provided original attribution is preserved and any use for commercial inference is disclosed to Echolight within 30 days." That last bit might be a problem for enterprise customers.

diego (product): If they require disclosure to Echolight for commercial uses that will block some marketplaces/customers. Can we offer a separate SKU for 'commercial redistributable' where Echolight gets notification but not approval? Also need clarity on quantized variants (q4/q8).

sanjay (eng): From infra side: we can host both full-precision and quantized variants, but note that the quantized builds are generated by us (we do the quantization) — need to ensure license permits us to produce and redistribute quantized artifacts. If addendum restricts derivative artifacts, that's a legal blocker.

tara (legal): Right. Two action items: 1) confirm whether "derivative formats" includes format-preserving quantization (we interpret it as yes). 2) negotiate that Echolight gets notification but not veto on commercial use. I'll draft a short addendum clause: "Echolight shall receive notification of listed commercial redistributions but may not withhold consent except for export control or IP infringement reasons." Thoughts?

echolight-contact: we can accept notification only. export control concerns are understood. embargo is non-negotiable for two weeks after sign-off.

diego (product): ok, that solves veto. Next: SKU mapping proposal for console and marketplace. Rapid draft: 
```
sku_map:
  echolight-research-v1: model-echolight-v1
  echolight-research-v1-q4: model-echolight-v1-q4 (Redwood-quantized)
  echolight-research-v1-enterprise: model-echolight-v1-enterprise (commercial redistributable)
```
This lets us expose pricing tiers and tag which ones require extra notification.

jenna (marketing): timeline: we want one joint announcement email + blog on launch day. Need co-brand assets by EOW (logos, short boilerplate, compliance statement). Who owns the embargo calendar?

morgan (partnerships): Echolight owns embargo window but we'll coordinate the calendar. Proposed launch plan: internal sign-off by 03/07, tech verification and SKU creation by 03/10, marketing assets by 03/11, public launch 03/18 (two-week embargo baked in).

tara (legal): I'll share a 2-line addendum and patch to the marketplace T&Cs for Echolight that specifies notification-only for commercial redistributions and export-control carveouts. Will ping @echolight-contact for countersign.

sanjay (eng): Technical checklist for eng verification:
- reproducibility test on our runtime (sample prompt)
- quantization smoke test (q4 and q8 accuracy delta check)
- license header embedded in artifact and packaging script
- ensure telemetry does not leak model provenance beyond notification
I'll open a PR with the test harness by EOD.

echolight-contact: signing the addendum tomorrow, will upload logos and a 1-paragraph boilerplate by Friday. thanks all. excited to launch with Redwood! :rocket:

morgan (partnerships): Great. I'll create the SKU ticket and calendar invite, loop in billing for enterprise SKU pricing, and post the final checklist once legal drops the addendum. Thanks everyone.
